text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: So exciting! It was seriously the best...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! A Santa-colored shark lunged 
out, went *CHOMP* with its mouth, and my 
heart just went *GASP*!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~ An amusement park at Christmas 
is... amazing!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"We gotta buy tons and tons of souvenirs 
for Cesario's Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Christmas-exclusive amusement park 
tickets? Trainer, this is...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Huh, a Christmas present...?!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Why are there portions for us as well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—The bond between classmates of the same 
generation is special. Even after 
graduating from Tracen Academy, this bond 
will support Cesario's—and everyone 
else's—dreams.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the more memories we make, the 
stronger that bond will become. That's 
why—
choice_data_list:
So it can serve as a foundation for your 
futures, I guess.

So it can serve as a foundation for your 
futures, I guess

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Besides—
choice_data_list:
After all, Christmas is a day to spend 
with someone precious.

After all, Christmas is a day to spend 
with someone precious, you know.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: With a precious partner...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your thoughtfulness, 
Trainer. --I will gladly accept.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, that's right! The four of us should 
play our hearts out and make some great 
memories♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's actively make use of 
the shortcut tickets. I believe that would 
be a more efficient way to play.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: You're right! First off, then—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Next, hard starboard!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Hard to starboard, roger that! Everyone, 
hold on tight! Heave-hooooo!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! Nice starboard turn, Kraft! We've 
got so much momentum we might sink!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, that's true. But wouldn't it be bad 
if it sinksâ

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeeek!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, is the scary thing gone yet? Is it 
really gone? Is it safe to open my eyes?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Both of you, stay behind me. Cesario, 
which way next?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
According to the clues, it seems to be to 
the right. I shall bring up the rear.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks! Now come on, we're all making it 
out alive!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Attraction complete! Attraction complete!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That was... the absolute best! We played 
to our hearts' content! I'm completely 
starving now!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Your dinner show reservation is in the 
Forest Area, correct? From here, it's—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: A dinner show, huh...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu. I bet they picked this out for me 
while taking nutritional balance and 
everything into account...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu! Hey, Cesario~ Who were you just 
thinking about?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let me guess! ...It's about your Trainer, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha... You caught me?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Knowing them, I bet they put themselves 
second and researched a ton in between 
their work for me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking about it like that, it made me 
treasure this day all the more..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what Trainer is up to right now? 
I hope you're at least enjoying Christmas 
a little bit, though...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Then—Let's go, Cesario!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Tap!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It seems the train is quite crowded. It 
might be better to just run there.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "Heart-san, Messiah-san...? Um..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about the cancellation! We'll 
all eat Cesario's share too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"—'Christmas is a day to spend with 
someone special!' Right, Cesario?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Craft... Yeah. Yeah, that's right, you did 
say that.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Phew... Thank you, everyone. I—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I saved the completed documents and 
stretched thoroughly. I only meant to do a 
little, but ended up doing full-on work.
choice_data_list:
I wonder if Cesario is having dinner right 
about now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Picturing them having fun brings a smile 
to my face. ...I think I'll buy myself a 
slightly fancy dinner on the way home 
today, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A convenience store, or the department 
store basement? Thinking over that, I 
stepped out the school gates..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Thank goodness we didn't 
miss each other...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My eyes widened, wondering why she was 
here... And from the looks of it, she 
seemed to be all alone.
choice_data_list:
What's wrong? What about the amusement 
park...?

What's wrong? What about the amusement 
park...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I was at the amusement park until just a 
moment ago. It was so, so much fun, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I found myself wanting to spend it with 
you, too. —Since today is a day to spend 
with someone special.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm sorry for being so greedy. 
But...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, my legs just wouldn't 
stop.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. There's a bench! Shall we sit 
here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I agreed to Cesario's 
suggestion, which was all well and good, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no way we could get into a 
restaurant on Christmas night without a 
reservation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Department store basements, convenience 
stores... Chicken and cakes were 
completely sold out across the board—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's piping hot...! I have to be 
careful not to burn myself...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, a special meat bun sitting 
sadly next to the register and a cup of 
warm tea became our Christmas dinner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzz bzz)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Hm? ...Ah!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Look, Trainer. It's from Craft!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So this is what a Christmas dinner is 
like. ...Everyone looks so happy♪
choice_data_list: (…Wish we had some cake over here too…)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though, in reality, there was no cake, let 
alone a tree, chicken, or illuminations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All I have is a steamed meat bun from the 
convenience store and a plastic bottle of 
warm tea. ...At this point, it's debatable 
whether this even counts as dinner.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. It's all right, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Admittedly, it does lack a bit of that 
Christmas feel, but—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Because you are here with me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even without a tree, even without a lavish 
dinner...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
As long as you have what's precious to 
you, that's all you need... right?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Now, let's eat before it gets 
cold♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Merry Christmas, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufufu. Now, let's eat before it gets col—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Wait, ah...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer's present...! I left it in the 
dorm...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Oh no, I'm always on the receiving 
end...! I'm so sorry, let me go get 
something for you right now—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: B-But! I can't just do that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shake my head, saying it's truly fine. I 
gaze at her puzzled expression with a 
smile.
choice_data_list: As for presents, I already got one, so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Something irreplaceable, something truly 
precious, right here.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Geez, you're just too kind.
